title: Document that the Operator overrides the template namespace
description:
## What does this MR do?

A `namespace` set in a configuration template for the GitLab Runner Operator has no effect. By default, job pods start in the namespace of the `Runner` resource. The Operator sets `KUBERNETES_NAMESPACE` on the runner pod ([where it is set](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gl-openshift/gitlab-runner-operator/-/blob/v1.54.0/controllers/runner/environments.go#L94-97), [where the value comes from](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gl-openshift/gitlab-runner-operator/-/blob/v1.54.0/controllers/runner/environments.go#L31-34)), and GitLab Runner prefers that value over the template at registration, as [the registration docs](https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gitlab-runner/-/blob/77694893f179d15714df0b01dcdfeb73c2fe558b/docs/register/_index.md#L551-554) describe.

This MR adds `kubernetes.namespace` to the known-issue table on the Operator configuration page, next to the other settings that need an environment variable. The default value is the namespace of the `Runner` resource.

With Operator v1.54.0 and GitLab Runner v19.5.0, job pods run in:

- the namespace of the `Runner` resource, when the template sets `namespace` or sets nothing;
- the namespace in `KUBERNETES_NAMESPACE`, when the ConfigMap named in `spec.env` of the `Runner` resource sets it;
- the namespace in `spec.namespace` of the `Runner` resource, when that field is set.

Outside the Operator, `gitlab-runner register` with `KUBERNETES_NAMESPACE` set also replaces the template's namespace. `gitlab-runner run` with the same `namespace` in `config.toml`, and no registration step, keeps it.

The Operator MR https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gl-openshift/gitlab-runner-operator/-/merge_requests/306 changes this precedence. The row can go once that ships.

## Related issues

https://gitlab.com/gitlab-org/gl-openshift/gitlab-runner-operator/-/issues/229 reports the same precedence, and the table already links it. The bot auto-closed it as stale on 21 September, and the Operator MR above still closes it.
